data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence (Gutenberg search, book page, Wikipedia author, Notes new note with the same template, Enter), but it lists derived values like life dates, release date and download count as parameters instead of just title and author. It also leaves out the "don't download" constraint and the "matching book by {author}" check (it opens the "top result"), and it doesn't say to switch tabs or exactly how to search Wikipedia, which makes it a bit under-specified to automate.
